# Command-line reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the click commands. Do not edit by hand. -->

The CLI is a stable surface from 1.0: commands, options, defaults and exit codes follow the
[stability policy](stability.md). `quin-scanner --version` prints the installed version and the report
schema version. Run `quin-scanner COMMAND --help` for the same information in the terminal.

## Exit codes

| Command | 0 | 1 | 2 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scan` | the scan completed (findings do not change the exit code) | invalid target, or the scan failed | invalid `--skills-baseline`, invalid config file, or a command-line usage error |
| `scan-batch` | every target was scanned | at least one target failed (reports for the others are still written) | invalid config file, or usage error such as a missing targets file |
| `scan-org` | every repository was scanned | the repository list could not be fetched, or at least one repository failed | invalid config file, or usage error |
| `skills scan` | no skill at or above `--fail-on` (default `high_risk`) | at least one skill at or above `--fail-on` | error (bad target, unreadable or unsafe zip, bad config or baseline), or usage error |
| `skills baseline` | baseline written | | error, or usage error |

## `quin-scanner`

```text
Quin Scanner — detect GenAI and Agentic AI applications in repositories.

Scans local directories, GitHub repos, or entire GitHub organizations to
identify LLM usage, AI agent frameworks, model configurations, prompt
templates, and tool definitions.

Targets accepted by the scan command:
  - Local path:          /path/to/repo
  - GitHub URL:          https://github.com/owner/repo
  - GitHub shorthand:    owner/repo
  - Azure DevOps URL:    https://dev.azure.com/org/project/_git/repo

Examples:
  quin-scanner scan ./my-project
  quin-scanner scan owner/repo --no-llm
  quin-scanner scan https://github.com/owner/repo -o yaml -d reports/
  quin-scanner scan https://dev.azure.com/org/project/_git/repo --azure-token $AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN
  quin-scanner scan-batch targets.txt -d reports/
  quin-scanner scan-org my-org --skip-archived --skip-forks
  quin-scanner skills scan ./my-skill.zip
  quin-scanner skills baseline ./skills -o skills-baseline.yaml

Environment variables:
  GITHUB_TOKEN          GitHub personal access token
  AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN    Azure DevOps personal access token
  OPENAI_API_KEY        OpenAI API key (for LLM analysis)
  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY     Anthropic API key (for LLM analysis)
  GOOGLE_API_KEY        Google GenAI API key (for LLM analysis)
```

```
quin-scanner [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

| Option | Type | Default | Environment variable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--version` | flag | off |  | Show the version and exit. |

## `quin-scanner scan`

```text
Scan a single repository for GenAI/Agentic AI indicators.

TARGET can be a local path, a GitHub URL, or owner/repo shorthand.

Exit codes:
  0  the scan completed (findings do not change the exit code)
  1  invalid target, or the scan failed
  2  invalid --skills-baseline, invalid config file, or a command-line usage error

Examples:
  quin-scanner scan ./my-project
  quin-scanner scan owner/repo --no-llm -o yaml
  quin-scanner scan owner/repo --min-confidence 0.7 -d reports/
  quin-scanner scan ./my-agent --detect-zino --no-llm
  quin-scanner scan ./my-agent --skills-baseline skills-baseline.yaml
  quin-scanner scan owner/repo --llm-provider anthropic --llm-model claude-sonnet-4-20250514
```

```
quin-scanner scan [OPTIONS] TARGET
```

Arguments: `TARGET`

| Option | Type | Default | Environment variable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--output`, `-o` | `json` \| `yaml` \| `html` \| `sarif` | `html` |  | Output format |
| `--output-file`, `-f` | text |  |  | Write output to a specific file |
| `--output-dir`, `-d` | text | `./report` |  | Write output to this directory (auto-names the file) |
| `--llm-provider` | text |  |  | LLM provider for agent intent analysis (openai\|anthropic\|google\|ollama\|openai-compatible) |
| `--llm-model` | text |  |  | Override the default model for the provider |
| `--llm-api-key` | text |  |  | API key (overrides env var) |
| `--config`, `-c` | text |  |  | Path to a scanner-config.yaml file |
| `--branch` | text | `main` |  | Branch to scan (for GitHub targets) |
| `--no-llm` | flag | off |  | Skip LLM analysis entirely (faster, no API key needed) |
| `--min-confidence` | number | `0.0` |  | Exclude artifacts below this confidence threshold (0.0–1.0) |
| `--github-token` | text |  | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | GitHub PAT (overrides GITHUB_TOKEN env var) |
| `--azure-token` | text |  | `AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN` | Azure DevOps PAT (overrides AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN env var) |
| `--openai-compatible-url` | text |  |  | Base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (vLLM, LiteLLM, Azure, etc.) |
| `--no-vuln-check` | flag | off |  | Skip vulnerability lookup (OSV + web search) |
| `--vuln-search-provider` | `perplexity` \| `gemini` \| `openai` \| `anthropic` \| `none` |  | `VULN_SEARCH_PROVIDER` | LLM provider for web-based vulnerability search (reuses that provider's API key env var) |
| `--detect-zino` | flag | off |  | Detect Zino SDK usage and classify the agent as governed (off by default) |
| `--skills-baseline` | text |  |  | Suppress skill findings listed in this baseline (from 'quin-scanner skills baseline') |

## `quin-scanner scan-batch`

```text
Scan multiple repositories listed in a file.

TARGETS_FILE should contain one target per line (local paths, GitHub URLs,
or owner/repo shorthand). Lines starting with # are ignored.

Exit codes:
  0  every target was scanned
  1  at least one target failed (reports for the others are still written)
  2  invalid config file, or usage error such as a missing targets file

Examples:
  quin-scanner scan-batch targets.txt
  quin-scanner scan-batch targets.txt -d reports/ -o yaml
  quin-scanner scan-batch targets.txt --no-llm
```

```
quin-scanner scan-batch [OPTIONS] TARGETS_FILE
```

Arguments: `TARGETS_FILE`

| Option | Type | Default | Environment variable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--output`, `-o` | `json` \| `yaml` \| `html` \| `sarif` | `html` |  | Output format |
| `--output-dir`, `-d` | text | `./report` |  | Directory for per-repo output files |
| `--llm-provider` | text |  |  | LLM provider for agent intent analysis (openai\|anthropic\|google\|ollama\|openai-compatible) |
| `--llm-model` | text |  |  | Override the default model for the provider |
| `--llm-api-key` | text |  |  | API key (overrides env var) |
| `--config`, `-c` | text |  |  | Path to a scanner-config.yaml file |
| `--no-llm` | flag | off |  | Skip LLM analysis entirely (faster, no API key needed) |
| `--github-token` | text |  | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | GitHub PAT (overrides GITHUB_TOKEN env var) |
| `--openai-compatible-url` | text |  |  | Base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (vLLM, LiteLLM, Azure, etc.) |
| `--no-vuln-check` | flag | off |  | Skip vulnerability lookup (OSV + web search) |
| `--vuln-search-provider` | `perplexity` \| `gemini` \| `openai` \| `anthropic` \| `none` |  | `VULN_SEARCH_PROVIDER` | LLM provider for web-based vulnerability search |
| `--detect-zino` | flag | off |  | Detect Zino SDK usage and classify the agent as governed (off by default) |

## `quin-scanner scan-org`

```text
Scan all repositories in a GitHub organization or user account.

ORG_NAME is a GitHub organization or user account name (auto-detected).
Discovers all repos via the GitHub API, then scans each one.
Requires a GITHUB_TOKEN with org/user read access.

Exit codes:
  0  every repository was scanned
  1  the repository list could not be fetched, or at least one repository failed
  2  invalid config file, or usage error

Examples:
  quin-scanner scan-org my-org --skip-archived --skip-forks
  quin-scanner scan-org my-org -d reports/ -o yaml --no-llm
  quin-scanner scan-org my-username --github-token $GITHUB_TOKEN
```

```
quin-scanner scan-org [OPTIONS] ORG_NAME
```

Arguments: `ORG_NAME`

| Option | Type | Default | Environment variable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--output`, `-o` | `json` \| `yaml` \| `html` \| `sarif` | `html` |  | Output format |
| `--output-dir` | path | `./report` |  | Directory for per-repo output files |
| `--github-token` | text |  | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | GitHub PAT (overrides GITHUB_TOKEN env var) |
| `--skip-archived` | flag | off |  | Skip archived repositories |
| `--skip-forks` | flag | off |  | Skip forked repositories |
| `--no-llm` | flag | off |  | Skip LLM analysis entirely (faster, no API key needed) |
| `--config`, `-c` | path |  |  | Path to a scanner-config.yaml file |
| `--openai-compatible-url` | text |  |  | Base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (vLLM, LiteLLM, Azure, etc.) |
| `--no-vuln-check` | flag | off |  | Skip vulnerability lookup (OSV + web search) |
| `--vuln-search-provider` | `perplexity` \| `gemini` \| `openai` \| `anthropic` \| `none` |  | `VULN_SEARCH_PROVIDER` | LLM provider for web-based vulnerability search |
| `--detect-zino` | flag | off |  | Detect Zino SDK usage and classify the agent as governed (off by default) |

## `quin-scanner skills baseline`

```text
Accept the current skill findings so later scans report only new ones.

Scans TARGET (same targets as 'skills scan') statically, with no LLM review, and writes
every current finding to FILE as a fingerprint (rule, skill, file and evidence, no line
numbers and no raw evidence). Review the file, add a 'note' to entries if you like, and
commit it. Then pass it to 'skills scan --baseline FILE' or 'scan --skills-baseline FILE'.

Exit codes:
  0  baseline written
  2  error (bad target, FILE exists without --force, cannot write FILE)

Examples:
  quin-scanner skills baseline ./skills -o skills-baseline.yaml
  quin-scanner skills baseline ./skills -o skills-baseline.yaml --force
```

```
quin-scanner skills baseline [OPTIONS] TARGET
```

Arguments: `TARGET`

| Option | Type | Default | Environment variable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--output`, `-o` | text |  |  | Baseline file to write (YAML) |
| `--force` | flag | off |  | Overwrite FILE if it already exists |
| `--config`, `-c` | text |  |  | Path to a scanner-config.yaml file |
| `--branch` | text | `main` |  | Branch to scan (for repo URL targets) |
| `--github-token` | text |  | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | GitHub PAT (overrides GITHUB_TOKEN env var) |
| `--azure-token` | text |  | `AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN` | Azure DevOps PAT (overrides AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN env var) |
| `--no-vuln-check` | flag | off |  | Skip OSV lookups for pinned skill dependencies |

## `quin-scanner skills scan`

```text
Scan Agent Skills on their own, e.g. before installing them.

TARGET is a skill directory, a .zip file, a GitHub/Azure DevOps URL or owner/repo.
Static by default; passing an LLM option (--llm-provider, --llm-model, --llm-api-key,
--openai-compatible-url or --config) adds the LLM review. Nothing in the target is executed.

Exit codes:
  0  every skill is below --fail-on (default: SAFE or CAUTION)
  1  at least one skill is at or above --fail-on (default: HIGH_RISK)
  2  error (bad target, unreadable or unsafe zip, bad config, missing or malformed baseline)

--baseline suppresses findings accepted earlier with 'skills baseline', so only new
findings are reported, scored and counted towards the exit code.

Examples:
  quin-scanner skills scan ./my-skill
  quin-scanner skills scan downloaded-skill.zip --fail-on caution
  quin-scanner skills scan ./skills --baseline skills-baseline.yaml
  quin-scanner skills scan https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/main/skills/pdf -o sarif -f skills.sarif
```

```
quin-scanner skills scan [OPTIONS] TARGET
```

Arguments: `TARGET`

| Option | Type | Default | Environment variable | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--output`, `-o` | `terminal` \| `json` \| `sarif` | `terminal` |  | Output format |
| `--output-file`, `-f` | text |  |  | Write output to a file instead of stdout |
| `--fail-on` | `caution` \| `high_risk` | `high_risk` |  | Exit 1 when any skill's verdict is at or above this level |
| `--llm-provider` | text |  |  | Enable LLM review with this provider (openai\|anthropic\|google\|ollama\|openai-compatible) |
| `--llm-model` | text |  |  | Override the default model for the provider |
| `--llm-api-key` | text |  |  | API key (overrides env var) |
| `--config`, `-c` | text |  |  | Path to a scanner-config.yaml file |
| `--branch` | text | `main` |  | Branch to scan (for repo URL targets) |
| `--no-llm` | flag | off |  | Never run the LLM review |
| `--github-token` | text |  | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | GitHub PAT (overrides GITHUB_TOKEN env var) |
| `--azure-token` | text |  | `AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN` | Azure DevOps PAT (overrides AZURE_DEVOPS_TOKEN env var) |
| `--openai-compatible-url` | text |  |  | Base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (vLLM, LiteLLM, Azure, etc.) |
| `--no-vuln-check` | flag | off |  | Skip OSV lookups for pinned skill dependencies |
| `--baseline` | text |  |  | Suppress findings listed in this baseline file (from 'quin-scanner skills baseline') |
